d: Microavia is a Dubai-based technology company developing autonomous Drone-In-a-Box (DIB) systems for border security, critical infrastructure protection, public safety, and the energy and oil & gas sectors. We maintain direct control over all key system components, including mechanical design, production, electronics, and software, and serve both commercial and government customers.

We are looking for a IT Support Specialist to take ownership of Microavia’s IT infrastructure across our office, engineering, and production facility. The role covers networks, servers, end-user systems, engineering software, and information security. It suits someone who works independently, takes security seriously, and enjoys supporting a hands-on technical team.
q: 5+ years of experience as a IT Support Specialist, ideally in an engineering, manufacturing, or technology company.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP, AWS.
Solid networking skills: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls (e.g., Fortinet, Cisco, MikroTik), and VPN.
Experience with backup solutions and disaster recovery planning.
Good understanding of information security principles and best practices.
Strong sense of responsibility and discretion when handling sensitive information.
Ability to work independently and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Azure Administrator, or Linux certifications (RHCSA/LPIC).
Experience administering CAD/PLM software and license servers (SolidWorks, Autodesk).
Experience with Git-based platforms (GitLab/GitHub) and CI/CD infrastructure.
Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
Experience in defense, security, aerospace, or other regulated industries.
Familiarity with UAE information security standards.
r: Administer and maintain servers, storage, and virtualization platforms (on-premise and cloud).
Design, configure, and support the company network: LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VLANs, firewalls, and VPN.
Maintain network segmentation between office, R&D, production, and test environments.
Monitor system performance and availability, and resolve incidents promptly.
Implement and maintain security controls: access management, MFA, endpoint protection, and patch management.
Protect sensitive engineering data, source code, and customer information.
Support isolated, offline environments used for product development and testing.
Support compliance with customer security requirements and applicable UAE regulations.
Investigate and respond to security incidents.
Set up and maintain engineering workstations and high-performance machines for CAD, simulation, and software development.
Administer engineering software and license servers (e.g., SolidWorks, PDM, development tools).
Support IT needs of the production floor: networked equipment, 3D printers, CNC machines, and test stands.
Work closely with engineering teams to provide the tools and environments they need.
Administer several AWS nodes used by production and engineering.
Administer Google Workspace: user accounts, email, and collaboration tools.
Provide Level 1–2 IT support to employees.
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding: accounts, equipment, and access rights.
Manage backups and disaster recovery, and regularly test restore procedures.
Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and vendor relationships.
Keep infrastructure documentation and procedures up to date.
x: Build and own the IT infrastructure of a fast-growing drone technology company.
Support a team developing autonomous systems used in real security and infrastructure operations.
Work in a hands-on environment where engineering, production, and software come together under one roof.

d: Swiss Rose is looking for a welcoming, organised colleague to help customers choose flowers and gifts, handle enquiries, and coordinate accurate orders from first contact through delivery and after-sales support. Location: On-site at Swiss Rose, West Abu Fatira Industrial, Mubarak Al-Kabeer, Kuwait. Applications are welcome from all genders. Fluent Arabic and working English are essential. RESPONSIBILITIES
Welcome customers and respond professionally to calls, WhatsApp messages and social media enquiries.
Understand the customer's occasion, preferences and budget; explain suitable flowers, gifts, availability and delivery options accurately.
Record orders carefully: product, recipient details, delivery address, requested date and time, gift-card message and special instructions.
Coordinate with the florist and management on designs, preparation, availability and changes requiring customer approval.
Follow approved prices, discounts and payment procedures. Verify payment through the authorised system before confirming an order as paid.
Follow up on enquiries and missing details, keep customers informed and escalate complaints or delivery issues promptly.
Request feedback and reviews through approved procedures, respecting customer consent and communication preferences.
Record enquiry sources and outcomes, distinguishing calls, WhatsApp enquiries, store visits and website orders.
Prepare a daily summary of enquiries, confirmed orders, pending follow-ups and unresolved issues.

Support simple product photography, Arabic and English captions and approved social media updates. HOW TO APPLY Submit your CV using the application form on the Swiss Rose website. In your short introduction, describe your flower/customer-service experience, Arabic and English skills, computer systems used and availability to start. Include relevant work samples only if you have permission to share them. Salary, work schedule and other employment terms will be discussed during the recruitment process.
